LanceBattleIntroText:
LANCE: I've been
waiting for you.

!

I knew that you,
with your skills,

would eventually
reach me here.

There's no need
for words now.

We will battle to
determine who is

the stronger of
the two of us.

As the most power-
ful trainer and as

the #MON LEAGUE
CHAMPION…

I, LANCE the drag-
on master, accept your challenge!
LanceBattleWinText:
…It's over.

But it's an odd
feeling.

I'm not angry that
I lost. In fact, I feel happy.

Happy that I
witnessed the rise

of a great new
CHAMPION!
LanceBattleAfterText:
…Whew.

You have become
truly powerful, .

Your #MON have
responded to your

strong and up-
standing nature.

As a trainer, you
will continue to

grow strong with
your #MON.
LancesRoomMaryOhNoOakText:
MARY: Oh, no!
It's all over!

PROF.OAK, if you
weren't so slow…
LancesRoomOakCongratulationsText:
PROF.OAK: Ah,
!

It's been a long
while.

You certainly look
more impressive.

Your conquest of
the LEAGUE is just fantastic!

Your dedication,
trust and love for

your #MON made
this happen.

Your #MON were
outstanding too.

Because they be-
lieved in you as a

trainer, they per-
severed.

Congratulations,
!
LancesRoomMaryInterviewText:
MARY: Let's inter-
view the brand new CHAMPION!
LancesRoomNoisyText:
LANCE: This is
getting to be a bit too noisy…

, could you
come with me?
LancesRoomMaryNoInterviewText:
MARY: Oh, wait!
We haven't done the interview!
